au.gst.registrationThreshold.label: GST registration turnover threshold (business)
au.gst.registrationThreshold.note: Register within 21 days of reaching it, on current or projected GST turnover.

au.gst.taxInvoiceThreshold.label: Tax invoice needed to claim a GST credit above
au.gst.taxInvoiceThreshold.note: GST-inclusive. A supplier must give a tax invoice within 28 days of a request above this amount.

au.gst.taxInvoiceBuyerIdThreshold.label: Tax invoice must identify the buyer from

au.gst.cashBasisTurnoverLimit.label: Cash-basis GST allowed below aggregated turnover

au.gst.simplerBasTurnoverLimit.label: Simpler BAS (G1, 1A, 1B only) is the default below GST turnover

au.gst.monthlyReportingThreshold.label: Monthly GST reporting required from GST turnover

au.bas.quarterlyDueDates.label: Quarterly BAS due dates (self-lodger)
au.bas.quarterlyDueDates.value: Q1 Jul–Sep: 28 Oct · Q2 Oct–Dec: 28 Feb · Q3 Jan–Mar: 28 Apr · Q4 Apr–Jun: 28 Jul
au.bas.quarterlyDueDates.note: Registered agents may get later dates; a weekend or public holiday moves the date to the next business day.

au.super.maxContributionBaseAnnual.label: Maximum contribution base (annual, 2026–27)
au.super.maxContributionBaseAnnual.note: From Payday Super the base is annual (concessional cap x 100 / SG rate, rounded down to $10).

au.super.paydaySuperStart.label: Payday Super starts
au.super.paydaySuperStart.note: Super is due with each payday and must reach the fund within 7 business days. The Small Business Superannuation Clearing House closed on 1 July 2026.

au.super.paydayDeadlineBusinessDays.label: Payday Super: business days for contributions to reach the fund

au.depreciation.instantAssetWriteOff.label: Instant asset write-off limit (per asset, turnover under $10m)
au.depreciation.instantAssetWriteOff.note: Made permanent from 1 July 2026. 'Less than $20,000'. A tax rule, not an accounting capitalisation policy.

au.corps.largePropAssets.label: Large proprietary company: consolidated gross assets

au.corps.largePropEmployees.label: Large proprietary company: employees at year end
au.corps.largePropEmployees.note: Large if at least two of the three tests are met (each figure is 'or more').

au.corps.largePropLodgeMonths.label: Large proprietary company: months after year end to lodge its financial report

uk.vat.returnDeadline.label: VAT return and payment deadline
uk.vat.returnDeadline.value: 1 calendar month and 7 days after the end of the VAT period
uk.vat.returnDeadline.note: Example: quarter ending 31 March is due 7 May. Late returns earn penalty points (periods from 1 January 2023).

uk.mtd.itsaStart.label: MTD for Income Tax: first group (qualifying income over £50,000)
uk.mtd.itsaStart.note: Over £30,000 from 6 April 2027; over £20,000 from 6 April 2028.

uk.nic.employerRate.label: Employer Class 1 NIC rate above the secondary threshold

uk.nic.secondaryThresholdAnnual.label: Employer NIC secondary threshold (annual)
uk.nic.secondaryThresholdAnnual.note: £96 a week, £417 a month. Fixed at £5,000 until 5 April 2028.

uk.cis.registeredRate.label: CIS deduction: registered subcontractor
uk.cis.registeredRate.note: Deducted from labour only: not from materials, VAT or the CITB levy.

uk.cis.unregisteredRate.label: CIS deduction: unregistered or unverified subcontractor

uk.ca.microBalanceSheet.label: Micro-entity: balance sheet total not more than

uk.ca.microEmployees.label: Micro-entity: average employees not more than

uk.ca.smallTurnover.label: Small company: turnover not more than
uk.ca.smallTurnover.note: £10.2m for periods from 1 January 2016 to 5 April 2025.

uk.ca.smallBalanceSheet.label: Small company: balance sheet total not more than
uk.ca.smallBalanceSheet.note: £5.1m for periods from 1 January 2016 to 5 April 2025.

uk.ca.smallEmployees.label: Small company: average employees not more than

uk.ca.mediumTurnover.label: Medium company: turnover not more than

uk.ca.mediumBalanceSheet.label: Medium company: balance sheet total not more than

uk.ca.mediumEmployees.label: Medium company: average employees not more than
uk.ca.mediumEmployees.note: A rise to 500 has been consulted on; not in force as at the verification date.

uk.ca.accountsDeadlineMonths.label: Private company: months after the accounting reference date to file accounts
uk.ca.accountsDeadlineMonths.note: First accounts: 21 months from incorporation or 3 months from the ARD, whichever is longer.

uk.ca.pscThreshold.label: Person with significant control: shares or votes held, more than
uk.ca.pscThreshold.note: Also: the right to appoint or remove a majority of the board, or significant influence or control.

uk.ca.idVerificationStart.label: Companies House identity verification for directors and PSCs
uk.ca.idVerificationStart.note: Existing directors supply a personal code with their next confirmation statement.

uk.frs102.periodicReview2024Effective.label: FRS 102 Periodic Review 2024 (leases on balance sheet, five-step revenue) effective for periods beginning on or after
uk.frs102.periodicReview2024Effective.note: Early adoption permitted. Supplier finance disclosures from 1 January 2025.

intl.ifrs16.shortTermMonths.label: IFRS 16 / AASB 16 short-term lease exemption: lease term of
intl.ifrs16.shortTermMonths.value: 12 months or less (with no purchase option)

uk.frs102.goodwillDefaultLife.label: FRS 102 goodwill: maximum life when it cannot be reliably estimated
